applies_to: Native-generation v2 quality lanes, before their first request
rejected_driver: Custom EOS row-compaction driver. All pilot_cap2048_v1 quality data are excluded.
data_selection: Original frozen question IDs and grouping remain unchanged.
answer_accuracy: Exact numeric or strict mathematical answer match, including a capped output with a valid final answer.
completed_answer_accuracy: Matching final answer and EOS completion. Separate conservative endpoint.
quality_rejection: A pilot QUALITY_FAIL requires a large paired regression on both answer accuracy and completed-answer accuracy. Truncation alone cannot establish a mathematical accuracy regression.
GO: No pilot GO. Both full canonical datasets and the specification quality thresholds remain mandatory.
EOS_padding: Official fixed-batch inactive padding is preserved. No logical output token or cross-request KV reuse occurs after EOS.
